omega.blurb: Launch site at the Omega Tower.

orbital.name: Orbital
orbital.blurb: Three stages up. The armour stays in orbit.

deorbit.name: Deorbit
deorbit.blurb: Fired at the planet and left to fall.

lunar.name: Lunar
lunar.blurb: Four stages. The middle one is not a rocket.

lunarOrbit.name: Lunar, direct
lunarOrbit.blurb: Nothing overhead and nothing to cross. Just the drive.

moon.name: Lunar
moon.blurb: Four stages. The middle one is not a rocket.

moonAir.name: Lunar, no belt
moonAir.blurb: A climb through weather nobody has littered.

moonOrbit.name: Lunar, direct
moonOrbit.blurb: Nothing overhead and nothing to cross. Just the drive.

zeta.name: Zeta Reticuli
zeta.blurb: Thirty-nine light years on a stack of drives.

zetaAir.name: Zeta, no belt
zetaAir.blurb: The stack, off a world with a clean sky.

zetaOrbit.name: Zeta, direct
zetaOrbit.blurb: Three liminal stages, thrown away one by one.

titania.name: Titania
titania.blurb: Jupiter, then a hole to another galaxy.

titaniaAir.name: Titania, no belt
titaniaAir.blurb: The slingshot and the jump, clean sky.

orbitalAir.name: Orbital
orbitalAir.blurb: Up to the ship. Nothing in this sky.

orbitalOrbit.name: Orbital, direct
orbitalOrbit.blurb: No air to climb through. Just the throw.

telemetry.padClear: Pad clear. Everyone is behind the berm.
telemetry.countStart: Terminal count running. The gun has the flight now.
telemetry.coilCharge: Banks charging. Rings coming up bottom to top.
telemetry.release: Release. The round is in the barrel.
telemetry.railExit: Rail exit. Two point four kilometres a second, and nothing burning.
telemetry.ballistic: Ballistic. No engine, no control, just the arc the gun gave it.
telemetry.maxQ: Max Q. The air is taking the paint off.
telemetry.thinAir: Air thinning out. Airframe loads dropping.
telemetry.ignition: Ignition at {alt}. There is finally nothing left to fight.
telemetry.karman: Karman line. Officially out of the sky.
telemetry.beltAhead: Belt ahead. Tracking has nothing useful to say.
telemetry.beltBare: Almost nothing left out there to lose. Hull {pct}.
telemetry.beltClear: Clear of the belt. Whatever that is, it is still flying.
telemetry.shipSighted: Starship in sight, coming up off the limb.
telemetry.aboard: Aboard. Hull {pct} and not one plate to spare.
telemetry.proximity: Proximity. Something big, and it is not slowing down.
telemetry.hopPadClear: Pad clear. Ground track laid to {dest}.
telemetry.hopCount: Terminal count. Suborbital profile, two stages.
telemetry.hopBallistic: Ballistic ascent. Nothing burning until the top.
telemetry.hopApogeeNear: Coming up on apogee. Ready to turn her round.
telemetry.hopFlipDone: Flip complete. Motor is pointed at {dest} now.
telemetry.hopPrograde: Flipped and burning prograde. The bell is pointed where we are going, so this slows us down.
telemetry.hopReentry: Reentry. The plume is the heat shield.
telemetry.hopTerminal: {dest} apron in sight. Lights are walking us in.
telemetry.hopMuzzle: {dest} gun has us. Muzzle is lit and the bore is charged to catch.
telemetry.hopCapture: In the bore. Rings firing in reverse - it is a brake now.
telemetry.hopBraked: Speed coming off hard. The banks are taking back what they spent.
telemetry.hopDocked: Docked in the breech. Hull {pct}, every layer still on her.
telemetry.hopArrived: Arrived at {dest}. Same round, different sea.
telemetry.deorbitClear: Bay clear. The rail has the round and the planet is where we left it.
telemetry.deorbitCount: Terminal count. Deorbit profile: nothing burns, we just fall.
telemetry.deorbitAway: Away, and pointed down. Nothing between us and the belt.
telemetry.entryInterface: Entry interface. Air ahead, and plenty of it.
telemetry.entryPlasma: Plasma. The shock is standing off the nose and the hull is a lamp.
telemetry.entryBlackout: Blackout. Nobody can hear us and nobody can help us.
telemetry.entryOut: Through it. Speed is coming off and the sky is blue again.
telemetry.chuteOut: Canopy out and full. Hanging under fabric.
telemetry.landingMuzzle: {dest} gun has us. Muzzle lit, bore charged, canopy away.
telemetry.landed: Down at {dest}. Hull {pct}, and the sea is on the right side of the window.
telemetry.chute: Drogue, then the main. That is the last of the speed.
telemetry.stageSep: Stage separation. Tanks dry, and it can go.
telemetry.stageLost: Stage is gone - something took the tanks off her. The burn was already made.
telemetry.deorbitFall: Thrown, and falling. Nothing is burning and nothing is going to.
telemetry.deorbitFalling: Still falling. The planet is doing all the work from here.
telemetry.shroudBlow: Belt is behind you. Blowing the drive shroud.
telemetry.shroudGone: Shroud away. The engine is in the open and it is clean.
telemetry.moonAhead: There it is. Dead ahead and holding.
telemetry.liminalSpool: Liminal drive spooling. Do not look at the core.
telemetry.liminalHot: The vanes are lit. Everything in here has two shadows.
telemetry.liminalGo: Drive is in. Range is collapsing - stand by for nothing at all.
telemetry.transitDeep: There is no outside. There is only the far end of it.
telemetry.moonFills: Range sixty kilometres. It is the whole window now.
telemetry.lunarSkim: Over the regolith. No air, so nothing slows you but you.
telemetry.baseSighted: The pad has you. Apron lamps are walking in.
telemetry.lunarFinal: Final. Drive to a crawl, and set her on the lamps.
telemetry.lunarArrived: Down on the Moon. Suits on before that hatch moves.
telemetry.lunarPadClear: Bay is clear. The Moon is where it always is.
telemetry.lunarCount: Lunar crossing, direct. No air out there and no belt either.
telemetry.lunarDrift: Drifting clear of the mast. Nothing burning, nothing needs to.
telemetry.lunarCapture: Capture. You are in orbit around the Moon.
telemetry.lunarOrbiting: Going round. The far side is as advertised: nothing at all.
telemetry.lunarDeorbit: Coming off the circuit. Drive down, nose on the base.
telemetry.cleanSky: Sky is clear all the way out. Nobody has left anything up there.
telemetry.cleanSkyCrew: No belt. I could get used to that.
telemetry.shroudClear: Sleeve is off. The drive has never seen daylight before.
telemetry.driftClear: Clear of the mast. Nothing burning, nothing needs to.
telemetry.moonOrbiting: Going round. The far side is as advertised: nothing at all.
telemetry.moonSkim: Over the regolith. No air, so nothing slows you but you.
telemetry.moonArrived: Down on the Moon. Suits on before that hatch moves.
telemetry.stackSpool: Liminal stack spooling. All three stages answering.
telemetry.stackHot: Three drives lit and the hull is singing with them.
telemetry.gateOpen: First stage in. Corridor is open - do not count the walls.
telemetry.gateSlabs: It is all colour. Slabs of it, going past like floors.
telemetry.stageOne: Stage one dry. Cut it loose.
telemetry.whiteIn: Third stage. Whatever is out there now, it is white.
telemetry.whiteSolids: Shapes. They turn in directions that are not there.
telemetry.whiteDeep: No colour left. Just white, and the black edges of things.
telemetry.stageThree: Last stage dry. That is the whole stack gone.
telemetry.zetaOut: Out. Zeta Reticuli, both suns, dead ahead.
telemetry.dysonSighted: They built shells around both of them. Both.
telemetry.zetaOrbiting: Going round. The Monument is down there somewhere.
telemetry.zetaSkim: Over the plain. Thick air out there, and it is breathable.
telemetry.zetaArrived: Down at the Monument. The air is fine. Take the helmet off.
telemetry.jupiterAim: Course is Jupiter. We are not stopping there.
telemetry.jupiterAhead: Jupiter ahead and it is the whole window.
telemetry.jupiterClose: We are going to hit it. Tell me we are not going to hit it.
telemetry.assistIn: Periapsis. The planet has you now.
telemetry.assistOut: Out the far side with Jupiter's own speed added to yours.
telemetry.escapeSpeed: Escape velocity and then some. Nothing can hold you now.
telemetry.lastPlanet: That was the last planet. There is nothing ahead of us at all.
telemetry.sbSpool: SB jump drive spooling. It has been dead weight since the pad.
telemetry.sbHot: Something is pulling. Not on the hull - on the space the hull is in.
telemetry.holeOpen: It is open. Two and a half million light years, and it is a ball.
telemetry.holeSphere: It is a SPHERE. There is another sky wrapped round the front of it.
telemetry.holeCommit: Committed. No abort past this point and no point wanting one.
telemetry.throatIn: Inside. Instruments have nothing sensible to say.
telemetry.throatDeep: The stars are in the wrong places and they are all still here.
telemetry.throatOut: Far mouth ahead. Stand by for a sky you do not know.
telemetry.andromeda: Andromeda. That is a different galaxy out there.
telemetry.theNeighbour: And that is the hole Titania goes round. They call it the neighbour.
telemetry.titaniaOrbiting: Going round. All of it is ocean and all of it is acid.
telemetry.titaniaSkim: Low over the ocean. Do not open anything.
telemetry.titaniaArrived: Down at the embassy. Suits stay on out here - that sea eats hulls.
telemetry.deorbitBurn: Coming off the circuit. Drive down, nose on the base.
telemetry.finalApproach: Final. Drive to a crawl, and set her on the lamps.
telemetry.hexIn: Second stage. Colour is draining out of the corridor.
telemetry.hexCompany: There is something out there keeping pace with us.
telemetry.zetaStar: Out beside the sun. That shell is the whole window.
telemetry.refuelIn: They have opened a tap for you. Tanks filling off the shell.
telemetry.refuelCrew: Somebody is giving us a star to drink.
telemetry.refuelDone: Tanks full. Nobody charged us anything.
telemetry.transferBurn: Burning across the system. The Monument is on the far side of it.
telemetry.transferCrew: A whole system to cross, and it is the short leg of this trip.

rattled.railExit: We are off the rail. We are off the rail, that was not - that was fast.
rattled.maxQ: Something is screaming. Is it meant to scream?
rattled.beltDeep: It keeps hitting us. {pct}. It keeps hitting us.
rattled.beltBare: There is nothing left on the outside. {pct}. Nothing.
rattled.beltClear: Is that it? Tell me that is it.
rattled.moonAhead: It is very big and it is getting bigger.
rattled.liminalHot: I can hear the drive through the frame. I can hear it in my teeth.
rattled.transitDeep: Do not look out. I looked out. Do not look out.
rattled.moonFills: That is the whole window. That is the whole window.
rattled.lunarArrived: Ground. Actual ground. I would like to sit down on it.
rattled.gateSlabs: The walls are going past and I cannot count them.
rattled.whiteSolids: They are turning inside themselves. Please stop looking.
rattled.jupiterClose: That is too close. That is far too close.
rattled.holeSphere: There is a sky inside it. There is another sky inside it.
rattled.throatDeep: I want to be anywhere that has a floor.
rattled.zetaArrived: Air. Real air. I am going to sit down in it.
rattled.titaniaArrived: Nothing comes off. Nobody take anything off.
rattled.hexCompany: Something is out there. Something is out there.

steady.railExit: Rail exit, clean. Two point four and nothing burning.
steady.maxQ: Through max Q. Airframe is holding.
steady.beltDeep: Still in the belt. Hull {pct}. Nothing structural yet.
steady.beltBare: Hull {pct}. Down to the frame and still flying.
steady.beltClear: Belt is behind us. Damage is cosmetic where it counts.
steady.moonAhead: Moon acquired, dead ahead. Attitude is holding.
steady.liminalHot: Drive at power. All three vanes even.
steady.transitDeep: Mid-crossing. Instruments are steady, which is the odd part.
steady.moonFills: Sixty kilometres. Coming in on the base.
steady.lunarArrived: Down and safe. Check seals before anybody moves.
steady.gateSlabs: Corridor is stable. Hull loads are nominal, oddly enough.
steady.whiteSolids: Four-dimensional. The instruments agree, which is the worrying part.
steady.jupiterClose: Periapsis on the numbers. She holds.
steady.holeSphere: Spherical mouth. The far sky is refracted round the whole of it.
steady.throatDeep: Instruments steady. Everything outside them is not.
steady.zetaArrived: Down and safe. Atmosphere reads breathable - confirm before helmets.
steady.titaniaArrived: Down. Nobody breaks a seal until I say so.
steady.hexCompany: Contact off the beam. Holding station with us. Noted.

hot.railExit: THAT is a gun. Do it again.
hot.maxQ: Max Q! Let it scream, it is meant to!
hot.beltDeep: Take it, then. {pct} and we are still going up.
hot.beltBare: Strip the whole thing off, see if I care. {pct}.
hot.beltClear: Through! Did you see what it took off us?
hot.moonAhead: There she is. Right in the middle of the glass.
hot.liminalHot: Light it. Light the whole thing.
hot.transitDeep: This is the best thing anyone has ever built.
hot.moonFills: It is enormous, it is enormous, look at the size of it!
hot.lunarArrived: We landed on the Moon. Somebody write that down.
hot.gateSlabs: Look at it GO. Look at the colours on it!
hot.whiteSolids: I have no idea what those are and I love them.
hot.jupiterClose: Closer! That is the whole point of a slingshot!
hot.holeSphere: We are going through a ball into another galaxy. Yes.
hot.throatDeep: Best corridor anybody has ever been down.
hot.zetaArrived: Thirty-nine light years. Somebody open something.
hot.titaniaArrived: Acid ocean! Do not touch it! I want to touch it.
hot.hexCompany: Let it keep up. It will not keep up for long.

warm.railExit: Everyone all right? Good. That was the worst part.
warm.maxQ: Breathe out. It sounds worse than it is.
warm.beltDeep: Hull {pct}. Hold on to each other and it will pass.
warm.beltBare: {pct}. We have lost the skin, not the people.
warm.beltClear: We are through. Everybody is here.
warm.moonAhead: Oh. Oh, it is lovely from here.
warm.liminalHot: The light is beautiful and I do not trust it at all.
warm.transitDeep: Look at each other, not out of the window. Just for a moment.
warm.moonFills: It fills everything. It is the colour of old bone.
warm.lunarArrived: We are down. Well done, all of you.
warm.gateSlabs: It is beautiful. Whatever else it is, it is beautiful.
warm.whiteSolids: They are almost gentle. Look how slowly they turn.
warm.jupiterClose: Hold on to something. It will be over in a moment.
warm.holeSphere: Somebody built that. Somebody built that for us.
warm.throatDeep: Everyone all right? Say something, any of you.
warm.zetaArrived: We are here. All of us, and the air is good.
warm.titaniaArrived: Helmets stay on. I know. I am sorry.
warm.hexCompany: Whatever is out there, it has not hurt us. Let it come.

dry.railExit: So that is what being fired out of a cannon costs. Noted.
dry.maxQ: Max Q. The paint is going. The paint was optional.
dry.beltDeep: {pct}. Somebody up here really ought to tidy up.
dry.beltBare: {pct}. We are a bullet with delusions now.
dry.beltClear: Out the other side, and only mostly ruined.
dry.moonAhead: The Moon. Still there. Still grey.
dry.liminalHot: Wonderful. The purple bit is on.
dry.transitDeep: I am going to pretend the outside is a screensaver.
dry.moonFills: That is quite close. That is quite close, actually.
dry.lunarArrived: The Moon. I was promised a beach.
dry.whiteSolids: Shapes in the void. Lovely. Is there tea?
dry.jupiterClose: Enormous ball of gas, no brakes. Cannot fault the plan.
dry.holeSphere: A hole. A round one. Naturally.
dry.throatDeep: I have stopped having opinions about the outside.
dry.zetaArrived: Thirty-nine light years for a statue.
dry.titaniaArrived: An ocean that dissolves you. Somebody put an embassy on it.
dry.hexCompany: Of course there is something out here. There always is.

precise.railExit: Muzzle velocity as advertised. Two thousand four hundred, near enough.
precise.maxQ: Dynamic pressure peaking. Ablation is on the published curve.
precise.beltDeep: Hull {pct}. Decay is exponential, as the model said it would be.
precise.beltBare: {pct}. The asymptote is holding. It will not reach zero.
precise.beltClear: Traversal complete. Losses within one per cent of prediction.
precise.moonAhead: Three hundred and eighty-four thousand kilometres. For about four more seconds.
precise.liminalHot: The core is not radiating. Whatever it is doing, it is not heat.
precise.transitDeep: Nothing out there is behaving. I am recording all of it.
precise.moonFills: Sixty kilometres. Angular size is off the top of the instrument.
precise.lunarArrived: One sixth gravity. Move slowly and think about it first.
precise.gateSlabs: Slit-scan. The bands are discrete and the spacing is logarithmic.
precise.whiteSolids: A tesseract, a 16-cell and a 5-cell. Projected, not imagined.
precise.jupiterClose: Periapsis inside two radii. The delta-v is worth every metre.
precise.holeSphere: A sphere, not a funnel. Every film but one gets that wrong.
precise.throatDeep: I am recording all of it and I will not be believed.
precise.zetaArrived: Surface gravity is about one and a half. Mind your knees.
precise.titaniaArrived: The ocean is pH zero and the hull is already etching.
precise.hexCompany: It is matching our velocity exactly. That is not a natural object.

tourists.zetaOut: You came! You actually came! Oh, we are SO pleased.
tourists.dysonSighted: You noticed the shells! Everyone notices the shells. Aren't they lovely?
tourists.capture: You are in orbit! Well done! Everybody wave!
tourists.zetaOrbiting: That is our best side. We tidied. You did not have to look but we tidied.
tourists.deorbitBurn: Coming down! Careful, careful. Not too careful. You are doing wonderfully.
tourists.zetaSkim: The air is lovely today. Breathable! For you! We checked specially.
tourists.baseSighted: We can see you! We are all outside! Some of us have made a sign!
tourists.finalApproach: Gently now. Gently. Oh, this is the best day.
tourists.contact: DOWN! You are down! Nobody touch anything, they are down!
tourists.zetaArrived: Welcome, welcome, welcome. Would you like to see the Monument? Say yes.

dargos.andromeda: Welcome to Andromeda. Please maintain your current heading. Do not maintain your current heading.
dargos.theNeighbour: That is the neighbour. Do not look at it. It likes being looked at.
dargos.capture: You are in orbit. You are not in orbit. Both readings are correct and we stand by both.
dargos.titaniaOrbiting: Reduce speed. Increase speed. Whichever you did, that was the other one.
dargos.deorbitBurn: Begin your descent immediately. Do not begin your descent. Acknowledge one of those.
dargos.titaniaSkim: You are too low. Also too high. Hold exactly where you are and also move.
dargos.baseSighted: We have you visually. We have never seen you. The embassy is delighted by both.
dargos.finalApproach: Land on the pad. The pad is a decoy. The decoy is the pad. Proceed.
dargos.contact: You have landed. Please confirm you have not landed.
dargos.titaniaArrived: Welcome to Titania. The sea is not dangerous. Do not go near the sea.
